source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: **Aura (9")**: during [your opponent's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), at its [Battle-shock step](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock-step), enemy units in range that are below their **Starting Strength** have to test for [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock). For this ability, a unit whose Starting Strength is 1 counts as below it while it has lost any wounds. Also, for each enemy unit up to 9" from this model that fails its Battle-shock test, this model gets back up to D3 of its lost wounds.

effects.condition: below Starting Strength or one-model starting unit with lost wounds

effects.trigger: enemy unit in range fails Battle-shock test
